{"pagination":{"count":10,"page":1,"next_page":2,"total_count":1000,"total_pages":100},"records":[{"platform":"desktop","title":"Silencio","url":"https://silencio.es","uuid":"94a84b2b-7693-4193-8fe5-2061065e2639","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/silencio.es/94a84b2b-7693-4193-8fe5-2061065e2639/preview_0.jpg","description":"A stark, archival minimalism with an almost museum-like restraint. The screen is built on a white-on-white foundation, using a very light gray wash and soft fade to create depth without visible weight. Floating product objects are isolated across the canvas like specimens in a catalog, each rendered with diffuse shadows, airy spacing, and a quiet, sculptural presence. Typography is tiny, understated, and highly disciplined, sitting at the center as a subtle index rather than a headline. The overall mood is austere, intellectual, and contemplative, with a premium editorial feel shaped by negative space, monochrome tonality, and exacting composition. There’s little decoration beyond the forms themselves, so the design relies on balance, precision, and silence to create impact."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Co Projects","url":"https://co-projects.xyz","uuid":"f404451e-34c6-4762-83bf-93e4e2885b02","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/co-projects.xyz/f404451e-34c6-4762-83bf-93e4e2885b02/preview_0.jpg","description":"A stark, gallery-wall style light interface built around extreme typographic scale and abstract geometric branding. The screen is almost entirely white, creating a clean canvas with a contemplative, editorial feel, while oversized black circular letterforms dominate the composition like monumental art pieces. The visual language is highly minimal and architectural: hard edges, precise alignment, and a subtle vertical divider introduce structure without softness or ornament. Navigation is tiny and restrained, sitting quietly at the top edge, which makes the massive central graphics feel even more emphatic. Typography appears crisp and modern, with a compact, academic tone and very little hierarchy beyond scale. The overall aesthetic is monochrome, austere, and concept-driven, with strong contrast, generous negative space, and a polished, poster-like presence."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Waka Waka","url":"https://wakawaka.world","uuid":"dbfdd355-b07e-40d6-9571-09284475794c","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/wakawaka.world/dbfdd355-b07e-40d6-9571-09284475794c/preview_0.jpg","description":"Waka Waka has a stark, editorial poster aesthetic with a refined gallery-wall sensibility. The composition is built around a centered, narrow off-white canvas that feels like a printed sheet pinned to a larger neutral field, giving the whole interface an artifact-like presence. Oversized black typography dominates the layout, especially the monumental Waka headlines, which are set with heavy weight and tight spacing to create a bold, almost magazine-cover impact. The visual hierarchy is driven by scale and whitespace rather than color or decoration, resulting in a disciplined, grid-based rhythm that feels curated and deliberate.

Photography is treated as the main visual counterpoint to type: isolated product shots of furniture, cropped tightly and placed in clean rectangular blocks with sharp edges. The images are quiet, studio-like, and monochromatic, reinforcing the restrained palette and print-forward mood. Small text labels and minimal navigation sit lightly at the edges, nearly disappearing into the overall composition, while the generous negative space keeps the layout airy despite the strong typographic presence. The surface treatment is flat and matte, with no visible rounding, shadows, or ornamental effects, which strengthens the crisp, contemporary editorial tone. Overall it feels premium, restrained, and highly art-directed, like a design catalog translated into a modern digital presentation."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"mostlikely","url":"https://mostlikely.at","uuid":"f28e4392-f903-4e65-8b7e-6f6599e2f905","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/mostlikely.at/f28e4392-f903-4e65-8b7e-6f6599e2f905/preview_0.jpg","description":"A stark monochrome design with an architectural, blueprint-like sensibility, rendered on a bright white canvas with pure black as the only visual counterpoint. The composition feels minimal yet graphic, with a thin bordered top navigation bar stretching across the width and compact, evenly spaced type that gives the interface a precise, utilitarian calm. Typography is small, clean, and technical in feel, reinforcing the restrained editorial tone. The main visual focus is made of large abstract black forms with a granular, speckled texture, creating a tactile, almost printed-material quality that contrasts sharply with the smooth white background. Sharp corners, thin lines, and flat surfaces dominate the system, producing a disciplined, structured look with a high degree of visual clarity. Overall it feels spare, refined, and deliberately severe, like a modernist design system filtered through architectural notation and material texture."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Aaron Poe & Co","url":"https://aaronpoeandco.com","uuid":"b5366346-8c4d-4b66-86e7-abbcd8259c85","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/aaronpoeandco.com/b5366346-8c4d-4b66-86e7-abbcd8259c85/preview_0.jpg","description":"A stark, editorial-style portfolio interface with a nearly all-white canvas and an intentionally restrained visual language. The composition feels centered and airy, with a small brand wordmark at the top left and a compact pill-shaped navigation bar near the top center that uses soft gray surfaces and subtle active-state treatment. Typography is the dominant design element: clean sans-serif text, tight spacing, modest weights, and crisp alignment create a polished, almost academic tone. The layout is minimal and highly disciplined, with a narrow text block centered in the page and generous negative space surrounding it, giving the screen a quiet, premium, gallery-like feel. Color is used sparingly; the palette is mostly black, white, and soft gray, with any emphasis appearing subdued and functional rather than decorative. There are no heavy shadows, no dense card systems, and no visual clutter, just a refined, contemporary design portfolio aesthetic built on precision, balance, and understatement."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"19–86","url":"https://19-86.fr","uuid":"7a8c99db-5ce7-4fa4-b491-8f1fcac18991","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/19-86.fr/7a8c99db-5ce7-4fa4-b491-8f1fcac18991/preview_0.jpg","description":"Minimalist architectural-archive aesthetic with a stark black-and-white palette and a blueprint-like sense of precision. The screen feels almost printed rather than designed, with crisp 1px horizontal rules, tight tabular alignment, and a full-width list structure that creates a technical, document-like rhythm. The typography is very light and refined, using a clean sans-serif with restrained letter spacing that gives the text an orderly, engineered quality. The oversized “19-86” dominates the composition like a typographic monument, floating over the grid with dramatic scale but no visual weight beyond pure black ink. Small dot markers and thin dividers act as understated interface details, reinforcing the calm, exacting, diagrammatic mood. There is very little ornamental treatment: no color variation, no shadows, no softness, just spacious white fields, disciplined spacing, and an elegant, archival clarity that feels both modern and строго technical."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Fonts In Use","url":"https://fontsinuse.com","uuid":"470e5fb7-8e29-4b30-acc5-fb2907d86b51","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/fontsinuse.com/470e5fb7-8e29-4b30-acc5-fb2907d86b51/preview_0.jpg","description":"A stark, editorial archive-style design with a clean academic feel and a disciplined monochrome palette. The interface is dominated by white space, crisp black typography, and subtle gray dividers, giving it the look of a carefully cataloged library or specimen index. The typography is the hero: oversized, condensed display lettering for the brand and section labels, paired with smaller, compact sans-serif body text that keeps everything dense, orderly, and highly readable. The layout is centered and grid-based, with strong horizontal structure, a thin top navigation area, and a tightly packed multi-column catalog of square content cards. Spacing feels precise and utilitarian, with modest gutters and restrained section breaks that emphasize structure over decoration. Card thumbnails act as the primary visual material, presented plainly and consistently with minimal framing, while labels and metadata sit directly beneath them in a layered but disciplined hierarchy. Controls and filters are understated, using small rectangular inputs, simple buttons, and minimal iconography with sharp corners and very light surface contrast. Overall, the design feels authoritative, archival, and typographically driven—more like a well-organized museum index or publishing reference than a decorative marketing site."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Mike Matas","url":"https://mikematas.com","uuid":"749d923d-8d1a-48f6-b4dc-da755fbf1c62","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/mikematas.com/749d923d-8d1a-48f6-b4dc-da755fbf1c62/preview_0.jpg","description":"A stark, editorial portfolio aesthetic with a monastic sense of restraint. The layout sits on an expansive white canvas with very little chrome, letting typography and a few carefully placed showcase images do all the work. The header is sparse and intellectual: a bold black name in a clean grotesk at the upper left, a small date beneath it, and faint gray utility links floating to the upper right. The overall hierarchy feels precise and unforced, with generous negative space creating a calm, gallery-like reading rhythm.

The visual language is almost entirely monochrome in the interface chrome, with high-contrast black text and soft gray secondary labels. The typography is the dominant design feature: large, confident, and understated, with a modern Swiss-editorial sensibility. Below the header, the page opens up into product showcase imagery—crisp device mockups and interface screenshots presented without decorative framing, shadows, or embellishment. The laptop and phone renders are clean and realistic, acting as quiet portfolio artifacts rather than atmospheric imagery.

The composition feels balanced between spacious minimalism and focused visual evidence. Rectilinear forms, sharp edges, and a lack of radius or effects give the whole screen a disciplined, almost architectural clarity. It reads as a refined designer portfolio or creative technologist showcase: minimal, intelligent, highly curated, and intentionally silent in color, relying on proportion, whitespace, and type weight for all sense of style."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Dul Zorigoo","url":"https://dzrgo.com","uuid":"d425c983-41e5-4f17-ab76-24aa15635024","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/dzrgo.com/d425c983-41e5-4f17-ab76-24aa15635024/preview_0.jpg","description":"A restrained, text-first portfolio/workbench aesthetic with a quiet editorial feel. The interface is built on a bright white canvas with very light gray dividers and almost no visual noise, letting typography and imagery carry the composition. Dark charcoal text provides crisp contrast, while muted secondary labels sit softly in the hierarchy. The layout feels deliberately measured: a narrow left-side introduction area, simple top filter pills, and a roomy multi-column grid of content blocks with consistent breathing space. Cards are flat and understated, with minimal framing and subtle separation rather than shadows or heavy containers. Imagery is a mix of monochrome and gently desaturated photography alongside clean product screenshots, arranged like curated research notes or a visual archive. Overall it feels calm, intelligent, and highly organized — a monochrome design system with a refined, modern, almost gallery-like sensibility."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Leonid Kostetskyi","url":"https://leonidkostetskyi.com","uuid":"377d2e4b-bbd8-46e1-8227-45568b4c6426","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/leonidkostetskyi.com/377d2e4b-bbd8-46e1-8227-45568b4c6426/preview_0.jpg","description":"A stark, type-led minimalist portfolio aesthetic with an architectural feel. The composition is built almost entirely from oversized typography set on a warm parchment canvas, using a deep cocoa-brown text color that feels refined and slightly vintage rather than harsh black. The layout is intentionally spacious and asymmetrical, with massive headline blocks anchored to the upper left and lower right, creating a dramatic sense of scale and tension. Small supporting text sits quietly in the margins, reinforcing a highly curated hierarchy. The interface feels almost poster-like: airy, restrained, and confident, with no visible chrome, shadows, or decorative container treatment. Navigation is tiny and tucked into the top-right corner, and interactive elements read more like understated text links than buttons. A subtle geometric emblem near the bottom left adds a minimal abstract accent, while the overall surface retains a lightly textured paper quality that softens the severity of the typography. The result is an elegant, editorial, modernist design language with a quiet brutalist edge."}]}
